strings.en: I did the very best I could! Thanks for{NEWLINE}your support!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 说到精灵对战{NEWLINE}就像写在沙滩上的爱的告白呢！
strings.en: A battle is... It is a love letter{NEWLINE}written in sand.
Do you understand? You don’t, do you?{SCROLL}
Do you understand? You don’t, do you?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 喂你！在那边的那个！{NEWLINE}稍微等等~！
strings.en: Hey, you! You over there! Wait a sec!

strings.zh: 喂喂,小孩子{NEWLINE}快点回家去！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey, hey, kids should hurry on home!{SCROLL}
Whoa, what did you do{NEWLINE}to a police officer?!!{SCROLL}
Mumble... mumble...
Heh heh... mumble...{NEWLINE}Wait for me... mumble...{SCROLL}
Mumble... Oh my... mumble...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 来陪我玩玩！{NEWLINE}华丽地赌一把吧！
strings.en: Come play with me!{NEWLINE}Let’s make a flashy bet!
Ha! Yes!{SCROLL}
You’re quite the gambler yourself!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 胜负的关键就是小心谨慎地{NEWLINE}计算好每一步！
strings.en: The key to victory is carefully{NEWLINE}calculating every move!
See? A victory as expected!{SCROLL}
See? A defeat as expected!{SCROLL}
Life rarely goes the way you want!
Hooray! Wishes come true!{SCROLL}
I told you...{SCROLL}
There’s nowhere to run or hide!
The outcome was{NEWLINE}decided from the start!{SCROLL}
Fare... thee... well...!!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 无论晴天还是下雨,{NEWLINE}我都在此寻找着厉害的训练师！
strings.en: I wait for tough Trainers here,{NEWLINE}come rain or come shine.

strings.zh: 感谢你让我变得{NEWLINE}这么强⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Thanks for making me this strong...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 有没有强大的,不是,比起这个,{NEWLINE}帅气的训练师在哪呀⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Is there a strong... no, better yet, a{NEWLINE}cool Trainer anywhere...{SCROLL}
This is a parasol!

strings.zh: 虽然对战很强,{NEWLINE}对阳光就完全没辙了⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m strong in battle, but I can’t stand{NEWLINE}the sun at all...{SCROLL}
I don’t want to get roasted!{SCROLL}
Well...{NEWLINE}Those are rare Pokémon...

strings.zh: 抓不到呢⋯⋯{NEWLINE}真是善变的精灵啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Can’t catch it... What a fickle Pokémon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎呀？你是训练师？{NEWLINE}原来不是精灵啊⋯⋯？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, you’re a Trainer?{NEWLINE}You’re not a Pokémon?{SCROLL}
All good?
All right!{SCROLL}
Bye!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 想战胜我{NEWLINE}你还早了十年呢！！
strings.en: Beat me?{NEWLINE}Try again in another ten years!
Way too green!!{SCROLL}
Amazing!! I’m so moved!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嗅到好闻的香气⋯⋯{NEWLINE}变得好困好想睡⋯⋯
strings.en: Smelling a nice fragrance...{NEWLINE}makes me so sleepy...
...Yawn...{NEWLINE}Oh? Are we finished so soon?{SCROLL}
...Yawn...{NEWLINE}Oh, really? I lost?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你没问题吧？{NEWLINE}人家可是超~强的哦！
strings.en: Are you sure you’re OK? I’m{NEWLINE}super-duper strong!

strings.zh: 没办法嘛！{NEWLINE}人家可是超~强的嘛！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Can’t be helped! I’m super-duper{NEWLINE}strong, after all!{SCROLL}
You’re super-duper incredible!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 对战是我生存的意义！{NEWLINE}对战是我人生的目标！
strings.en: Battling is my reason to live! Battling{NEWLINE}is my goal in life!
...Naturally.{SCROLL}
What on earth are you...?{SCROLL}
